St. John vacations Hotel + flightHotel onlyLeaving From Going To Departure - Return 4 Nights Anytime Rooms - Travelers1 Room, 2 AdultsSearch Things to do Top beach resorts FAQ The smallest of the U.S. Virgin Islands, St. John, is the ideal island to find a peaceful, tranquil paradise. Over 60 percent of the island is covered with a national park, so overcrowding is not an issue. Plus, St. John hosts beautiful beaches like Cinnamon Bay, Salt Pond Bay, and the famous Trunk Bay (one of the most popular and most photographed beaches in USVI)! On St. John, visitors can explore the natural beauty and easily island-hop to St. Thomas or St. Croix for the day. Not seeing many all-inclusive deals here? Discover St. John beach experiences Best of St. John St. John Brewers Located on the second floor of Mongoose Junction, St. John Brewers is a local brewery not to be missed. Starting with a dream and a love for the island life, the brewery crafts its own beers and sodas, including the flagship beer, Mango Pale Ale. Made from the local fruit, it’s a unique and delicious treat for travelers! Read more Hiking trails While St. John has over 20 trails to choose from, Ram Head Trail is a favorite! The trail is definitely a challenge but well worth it with its 360 views of the ocean and other islands at the top. Enter near Salt Pond Bay and make sure to go earlier in the day – there is little shade on the trail, so it can get hot. Another hike that will satisfy your nature craving is Reef Bay Trail, with it's shaded 2.2 mile-long trails that end at a beautiful beach. Read more Unique eats The island boasts some of the freshest food in the Caribbean. Try the Longboard Coastal Cantina for a variety of seafood, vegetarian/vegan, and gluten-free options! Plus, they make their own ginger beer and grapefruit soda in-house! Pizza Pi is another St. John treasure. This food boat serves awesome pizzas, has 3 seasonal menus, and offers the coolest concept around!
